title: Yukta message envelope v1, output
description: One output message a plugin writes to stdout; several outputs are written one object per line. Yukta treats the output as untrusted: anything not allowed here is refused. Engine fields (ids, trace, workflow) cannot be set.

port.description: One of the ports declared in the manifest; the first declared port when absent.

metadata.description: Entries added to the message's metadata.
